subject.title: I updated Scrapling and the skill became hidden again

question: Should the current Scrapling hidden state be restored as a false positive, kept hidden under policy, or treated as a publish/update regression that needs a code fix?
rationale: Only private production moderation/audit state plus maintainer policy intent for scraping skills can safely decide whether public visibility should be restored or preserved as a security hold.

options.title: Private moderation review and restore if false positive
options.body: Inspect the production moderation record and restore or manually override the skill if the scanner or publish flow produced an unintended hide.

options.title: Keep hidden under policy
options.body: If current policy blocks this class of scraping skill, explain that outcome to the reporter and continue the policy discussion at https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2321.

options.title: Open a focused code fix
options.body: If audit data shows an update-flow regression, keep this issue open as the user-facing report and patch the publish/review path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Private moderation review and restore if false positive
recommendation.body: Inspect the production moderation record and restore or manually override the skill if the scanner or publish flow produced an unintended hide.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest recent history across moderation visibility, staged publish recovery, ClawScan dispatch, and the prior Scrapling incident response.
